_about: Works with your version: the models tested with this version of Othos, per job. model_check.py (the weekly model check, 'Check models...' in the Othos window) compares this list, and newer releases in the same model families, with what's installed. It only lists; nothing is downloaded. Update this file when a new model has been tested, and give the date in tested_on.
_jobs: tag = the Ollama name; download_gb = its download; memory_gb = what it needs to run with a short context; runs_on = gpu (the graphics card, CPU if there's none) or cpu (always the CPU); cpu_quick_gb = above this a model answers too slowly on a CPU for a conversation; tested = false for a model planned but not run yet; families = Ollama library names counted as the same family (regular expressions; a newer release in them is listed as 'new, not tested yet'); skip = names in those families that are a different kind of model; hf = Hugging Face searches for GGUF files (for llama-server): a trusted publisher (author) and a word in the name.

models.note: the default; the only one quick enough on a CPU
